name: Secure Analytics Pro
highlights: Full-stack analytics app: a FastAPI, Polars and DuckDB engine cleans messy CSV, JSON, Excel and Parquet files, logging every repair, then ranks insights such as drivers, anomalies, trends and forecasts.
Detects 13 kinds of personal data (Luhn-checked card numbers, IBANs, emails, phone numbers and more) and masks or redacts them by default across previews, SQL, AI answers and exports.
Supabase backend with forced Row Level Security in a private schema, a least-privilege engine role, ES256 token checks against JWKS and instant session revocation.
Per-dataset AES-256-GCM encryption with crypto-shredding, an append-only hash-chained audit log, and a DuckDB SQL sandbox with an optional Claude analyst.
